messages:
maria: Heads-up: PR #4827 needs a small snippet showing how quota tiers map to per-minute allowances + localized billing examples (USD/EUR). Can someone add a compact SDK example and a one-paragraph migration note? cc @jon @vela
jon: I can add the SDK snippet. Question: should we show both per-minute and per-day calc formulas or just one? UX wanted short copy.
vela: Short only, but include the formula line and a tiny worked example for a 3-tier plan. Also mention rounding behavior for locales (comma vs dot).
liam: I'll do the locale note and attach the dashboard panel link. Panel URL: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/usage-tiers/panel-9 (internal). Will grab a screenshot.
maria: Nice. For the snippet use the JS SDK pattern we use in other docs, but keep it compact. Example:```js
// estimate tokens & allowance by tier
const tiers = [
  { name: \"starter\", per_min: 30, per_day: 1000 },
  { name: \"scale\", per_min: 300, per_day: 10000 },
  { name: \"enterprise\", per_min: 1000, per_day: 50000 },
];

function allowanceFor(tier, minutes = 1) {
  return Math.round((tier.per_min * minutes) * 100) / 100;
}

// example
console.log(allowanceFor(tiers[1], 5)) // 1500
```
jon: I'll PR with the JS snippet and add a one-line formula: `allowance = per_min * minutes` and a quick worked example. I'll also reference the metering header migration note.
vela: Please add a tiny note about locale rounding and separators. e.g., in de_DE costs display as `12,50 €` vs `12.50 USD`. That was a customer confusion case.
liam: Adding a Python snippet for locale formatting for the billing example (super tiny):```py
# Python example for cost formatting by locale
import locale
locale.setlocale(locale.LC_ALL, 'de_DE.UTF-8')  # German
cost = 12.5
print(locale.currency(cost))  # '12,50 €'
```
jon: I'll include both snippets in the PR and a short migration callout: "If you depended on the old per-minute header, switch to `X-Redwood-Usage-Tier` and use the mapping table below." Will add a short table-like code block for the mapping.
maria: Good. Also add a note about rounding: we always round allowances down to the nearest whole token for enforcement, but display uses two-decimal places for cost estimates.
vela: Don't forget to ping @docs-bot for an l10n pass before merge.
docs-bot: l10n-check queued for PR #4827. ETA 12h :gear:
maria: Action items: jon - add JS + one-line formula; liam - add dashboard link & screenshots; vela - locale note + short phrasing; I'll merge once l10n passes. Thanks :thumbsup:
